content: Solomon Sohpeisang Koht
Solomon limpoak ong lihen liki tohto. E pil pwoudikihda lihen Id, Mohap, Ammon, Edom, oh Saidon, likin sapwellimen nanmwarkien Isip serepeino.
E pwoudikinirailda mehndahte KAUN-O eh ketin mahsanihong mehn Israel re en dehr pwoudiki aramas pwukat, pwehki ar pahn kahrehiong mehn Israel ar pahn loalopwoatohngala koht teikan.
Solomon pwoudikihda serepein isipwiki oh pekehiki serepein silipwiki. Serepein ko kahrehiong eh sohpeisang Koht,
oh ni ahnsou me e likeilapalahr re kahrehiong en pwongih koht en liki kan. E sohte loalopwoatohng KAUN-O eh Koht, duwehte seme Depit.
E kaudokiong Asdarde, koht lihen Saidon, oh Molek, koht saut en mehn Ammon kan.
E dipada ong KAUN-O oh sohte loalopwoatohng duwehte seme Depit.
E ketin kauwada nin nahna palimesehn Serusalem wasahn kaudokiong Kemos, koht saut en mehn Mohap, oh wasahn kaudokiong Molek, koht saut en mehn Ammon.
E pil kauwada wasahn kaudok kei pwe eh pwoud en liki kan en kak isik warpwohmwahu ie oh wia meirong ong arail koht kan.

Mehndahte KAUN-O, Koht en Israel eh ketin pwarohng Solomon pak riapak oh mahsanihong en dehr pwongih koht en liki kan, Solomon sohte peikiong KAUN-O ahpw sohpeisang. KAUN-O eri ketin engiengda pahn Solomon
oh mahsanihong, “Pwehki omw nsenki kauwehla omw inou ong ie oh sohte kapwaiada ei kosonned, I inoukihda me I pahn kihsang uhk wehio oh kihong emen noumw lapalap akan.
Ahpw pwehki semomw Depit, I sohte pahn wia met nindokon omw momour, ahpw ni ahnsou me noumw pwutak pahn uhd kaunda wasa.
Oh I sohte pahn kihsang wehio pwon; ahpw, I pahn mweidohng kadaudok ehute pwehki ei ladu Depit oh pwehki Serusalem, kahnimw me I kin loalloale.”
Sapwellimen Solomon Imwintihti kan
KAUN-O eri ketin kupwurehda pwe Adad, kisehn peneineien nanmwarkien Edom, en uhwong Solomon.

Ahnsou reirei mwohn mwekid wet, ni ahnsou me Depit kalowehdi Edom, Sohap, kaunen sapwellime karis kan kolahngehr wasao pwehn sarepedi me melahr akan. Ih oh nah ohl akan mihmihki nan Edom erein sounpwong weneu, oh erein ahnsowo re kemehla ohl koaros nan Edom,
ihte Adad oh ekei nein eh pahpa ladu, me pitla oh sopolahng Isip. (Ni ahnsowo Adad wia seri men.)

Re mweselsang Midian oh kolahng Paran, wasa me ohl ekei pil iangirailda sang ie. Re ahpw seiloaklahng Isip oh kohla rehn nanmwarki. Nanmwarkio ahpw ketikihong Adad sahpw ehu oh ihmw oh pil kisin mwenge.
Adad eri kenikenla pahn nanmwarkio, e ahpw ketikihong en pwoudikihda rien eh pwoudo, rien lih nanmwarki Tapenes.
Serepeino eri naitikihada pwutak emen, ede Kenupad, me lih nanmwarkio apwalihada nan tehnpaso, wasa e kin koukousoan ie rehn sapwellimen nanmwarki pwutak ko.
Ni ahnsou me rohng lel Adad nan Isip me Depit sipallahr oh Sohap me kaunen karis ko pil melahr, Adad ahpw patohwanohng nanmwarkio, “Komw kupwureiehla pwe I en pwuralahng nan uhdahn sapwei.”

Nanmwarkio ahpw sapeng, mahsanih, “Pwekida? Mie mehkot me ke sohte itarki rehi? Ih kahrepen omw men pwuralahng nan uhdakomw?” Adad ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Komw ketin mweidohng ie pwe I en patopatohla,” Nanmwarkio eri mweidohng, ih eri kohkohla. Adad me iei nanmwarkien Edom, iei ih ohl suwed men, imwintihti kowahlap en Israel.
Koht pil ketin kupwurehda pwe Reson nein Eliada en uhwong Solomon. Reson sopohsang eh soumas, Adadeser, nanmwarkien Sopa,

oh wiahla kaunen pwihn loallap ehu. (Met wiawiher mwurin Depit eh kalowehdi Adadeser oh kemehla ienge mehn Siria kan.) Reson oh nah pwihno kohla kousoanla nan Damaskus, wasa me nah ohl ako wiahkihla ih nanmwarkien Siria.
E wia imwintihti en Israel nindokon Solomon eh momour.
Sapwelimen Koht Inou ong Seropoham
Pil emen ohl me uhwong Nanmwarki Solomon, iei emen sapwellime lapalap ako, Seropoham nein Nepat, mehn Sereda nan Epraim. Eden eh nohno, Serua, liohdi men.
Eri, iet koasoiepen uhpene wet: Solomon ketin audaude wasa kis ni palimesehn Serusalem oh pil pepeusehla kehl akan en kahnimwo.

Seropoham ohl pwulopwul koahiek men; eri, ni ahnsou me Solomon ketin mwahngihada duwen pwerisek en mwahnakapw menet, e ahpw kasapwilada pwe en kakaun tohndoadoahk koaros en sapwen kadaudok en Manase oh Epraim.
Rahn ehu, Seropoham ahpw seiloak sang Serusalem; e ahpw tuhwong soukohp Ahisa mehn Sailo nanial likin kahnimwo.
Ahisa ahpw pwuhrsang nan likou puhp kapw ehu me e likilikawih, ih eri tehrpeseng likou puhpo oh wiahkihda pelien likou eisek riau.
E ahpw ndaiong Seropoham, “Ale meh eisek, pwehki KAUN-O, Koht en Israel, mahsanihong komwi, ‘I pahn ketikihsang Solomon wehio, oh I pahn ketikihong uhk kadaudok eisek.
Ahpw Solomon pahn kolokol kadaudokteieu, pwehki nei ladu Depit, oh pwehki kahnimw Serusalem, kahnimw me I piladahr sang nan Israel pwon pwe I en ahnekihla.

I pahn wia met pwehki Solomon eh keseielahr oh pwongih koht teikan: Asdarde, koht lihen Saidon, Kemos, koht en Mohap, oh Molek, kohten mehn Ammon. Solomon sohte peikiong ie, e wiadahr me sapwung, oh solahr kapwaiada ei kosonned oh mahsen kan, duwehte me seme Depit kin wia.
Ahpw I sohte pahn kihsang wehio pwon, ahpw I pahn mweidohng en ahneki manaman erein eh mour, pwehki ei ladu Depit me kahrehda, me I piladahro, oh me kin kapwaiada ei kosonned oh mahsen kan.
I pahn kihsang nein Solomon pwutako wehio, oh uhd kihong uhk kadaudok eisek.

I pahn mweidohng nein Solomon pwutako en kolokol kadaudok ehu, pwe ahnsou koaros emen kadaudok en ei ladu Depit pahn kin kakaun nan Serusalem, kahnimw me I piladahro pwe en kin wia wasa ehu me aramas akan pahn kadaudok ong ie.
Eri, Seropoham, I pahn kasapwiluhkada pwe ke en wiahla nanmwarkien Israel, oh ke pahn kakaun uwen laud en sahpw me ke mwahuki.

Ma ke pahn peikiong ie ni unsek, oh momourki ei kosonned akan, ma ke pahn kapereniehda pwehki omw kapwaiada ei mahsen kan, duwehte me ei ladu Depit wiahier, eri, I pahn ieiang uhk ahnsou koaros. I pahn kasapwiluhkada pwe ke en wiahla nanmwarkien Israel, oh I pahn mweidohng kadaudokomw kan re en kin kaunda mwurimw, duwehte me I wiahiong ei ladu Depit.
Eri, pwehki dipen Solomon I pahn kaloke kadaudok en Depit kan, ahpw kaidehn ahnsou koaros.’”
Eri, Solomon ahpw kupwurehda en kemehla Seropoham. Seropoham ahpw tangalahng rehn Sisak, nanmwarkien Isip, oh kousoanla wasao lao Solomon pwoula.
Sipallahn Solomon
Eri, ekei en Solomon wiewia kan, duwen sapwellime mour oh erpit koaros, ntinting nan pwuhken Poadopoad en Solomon.
E ketiket Serusalem oh wia nanmwarki men nan Serusalem oh kakaun Israel pwon erein sounpar pahisek.
E sipalla oh seridi nan Kahnimw en Depit, oh sapwellime pwutak Reopoham me uhd wiliand wiahla nanmwarki.
